items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: she was a tuberculosis specialist, but I had pleurisy. Dr. Robie.

ctx.x: Yes sir. I was getting ready to tell you something now. My mother felt like she wanted to kill him. She wanted to go and get her boss's gun and kill him. But I guess the presence of it pressed on her mind and she didn't do it. And when she carried me to the doctor, and they had what you call -- she was a tuberculosis specialist, but I had pleurisy. Dr. Robie. I don't know if she's dead or alive today. But that woman was something else.

But she told my mother and she examined me, and told her it was just a matter of time -- too late. That's medical science for you. I was 15. I can tell you how old I was then. I was 15 years old -- or 16. Somewhere in there, 15 or 16. And here I am, that young, gonna die with pleurisy?
